scope: Existing server-reported per-slot response timings only; not exclusive graph CPU times or independently measured semantic phase windows
interpretation: A get_timings emits n*1000/ms; same response formula verified for every B0/A warmup and measured output
First decoded token sets t_start_generation and closes prompt timer; these slot intervals can overlap other slots
No aggregate tokens/s formed by summing these per-request rates; primary remains cohort HTTP throughput
